title: Legal Executive
description:
Job Description

**Job Opening:** Legal Executive

**Company:** AAAPRASAD Group

**Position:** Legal Executive

**Salary:** ₹15,000 per month

**Gender Preference:** Any

**Experience:** Minimum 1 Year

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Job Responsibilities**

Draft, review, and maintain legal documents, agreements, contracts, notices, and official correspondence.

Handle property and real-estate-related legal documentation.

Verify property papers, title documents, deeds, agreements, and other legal records.

Coordinate with advocates, legal consultants, government departments, and concerned authorities.

Maintain proper records of legal cases, agreements, compliance documents, and legal correspondence.

Follow up on ongoing legal matters and documentation.

Assist management with legal and regulatory compliance.

Prepare legal notices, replies, letters, and other required documents.

Ensure proper filing and timely completion of legal documentation.

Candidate Requirements

LL.B. / Law Graduate preferred.

Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience.

Knowledge of property law, contracts, agreements, and legal documentation.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Working knowledge of MS Word and Excel.

Experience in real estate or corporate legal work will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate

Candidate with at least 1 year of legal experience, preferably in real estate, property documentation, or corporate legal work.

Salary: ₹15,000 per month

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Accounts Executive – GST Compliance
description:
Ambey Group is looking for a detail-oriented and responsible **Accounts Executive** with a B.Com degree and 1–2 years of experience in accounting and GST compliance. The candidate should have a sound understanding of basic accounting principles, GST-related documentation, and routine accounting operations, preferably in the real estate or construction industry.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain day-to-day accounting entries, including purchase, sales, receipts, payments and journal vouchers.
* Prepare and maintain GST-related records, invoices and supporting documentation.
* Assist in the preparation and filing of GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.
* Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records and assist in Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation.
* Verify GST invoices, vendor bills and other supporting documents for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain vendor accounts, customer ledgers and general ledger entries.
* Assist in bank reconciliation and periodic account reconciliation.
* Coordinate with vendors, internal departments and consultants regarding GST and accounting-related matters.
* Maintain proper documentation and records for GST audits, statutory audits and internal verification.
* Assist in TDS-related documentation and other routine compliance activities, as required.
* Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned by the reporting manager.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* B.Com graduate from a recognised university.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in accounting, particularly GST-related work.
* Basic knowledge of GST provisions, invoicing and return filing procedures.
* Practical understanding of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation and Input Tax Credit.
* Working knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime and MS Excel.
* Good numerical, analytical and reconciliation skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining financial records.
* Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with experience in real estate, construction or a CA firm will be preferred.
* Familiarity with accounting software and GST portal operations.
* Ability to manage routine accounting tasks within prescribed deadlines.
* Honest, organised, proactive and willing to learn.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
